name: Technology modernization
description: Find explicit evidence of a migration, legacy-system burden, or integration program. A match is evidence to review, not an assertion that the company will hire external help.

evidenceRules.label: Platform migration
evidenceRules.suggestion: Explore a phased migration plan and delivery support.
evidenceRules.question: Which platform migration has the highest operational risk this year?

evidenceRules.label: Legacy-system burden
evidenceRules.suggestion: Explore modernization priorities and constraints in the legacy estate.
evidenceRules.question: Which legacy system is most limiting the team today?

evidenceRules.label: Integration program
evidenceRules.suggestion: Explore integration architecture and delivery capacity.
evidenceRules.question: Which integration is blocking the broader modernization program?
